panel.headline: Your property services, in one trusted place.
panel.body: Manage requests, visitors and community updates with role-based access.
panel.footnote: Protected by encrypted sessions and automatic timeout.

login.title: Sign in to CivicKey
login.subtitle: Use the phone number registered with your property.

errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
errors.inactive: This account is inactive. Contact property support.
errors.roleMismatch: This account is not registered as {{role}}. Select the correct role and try again.
errors.validation: Check your phone number and password, then try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.network: Can't reach CivicKey. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

session.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

setPassword.title: Set your CivicKey password
setPassword.intro: The society office issues a one-time code. Use it here to choose your own password.

have.title: I have a code
have.description: Enter the code the office gave you and choose a password. The code works once.
have.codeHint: Twelve letters and numbers. Spaces and dashes are fine.
have.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with a letter and a number.

ask.title: I need a code
ask.description: We will tell the society office that you cannot sign in. Collect the code from them.
ask.doneDescription: Ask the society office for your one-time code. For your safety we never say whether a number is registered.

done.title: Your password is set
done.description: Any device that was signed in with the old password has been signed out.

shell.comingSoon: This section is not available yet.

denied.title: You don’t have access to this area
denied.description: Your {{role}} role cannot open this page. Return to an allowed area, or contact your society administrator if you think this is a mistake.

activity.title: My activity
activity.intro: Everything that has happened on your flat, newest first.
activity.timelineDescription: Visitors, passes, bills and requests, read from the records themselves.

events.visitWaiting: {{name}} is at the gate for {{flat}} and is waiting for your answer
events.visitLeftAtGate: You asked the guard to keep {{name}} at the gate
events.passCreated: You made a pass for {{name}}, code {{code}}, for {{date}}
events.billDue: Your {{month}} bill of ₹{{amount}} is due on {{date}}
events.requestPending: You asked the office to add {{name}}

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.description: Visitors, passes, bills and requests will appear here as they happen.

myFlat.intro: The flat the society office has assigned to you.
myFlat.ceasedNote: This assignment has ended, so it no longer gives you access to the flat. Ask the society office to register you again.
myFlat.waiting: The society office has not verified this registration yet. You get access once it is approved.
myFlat.viewOnly: You have view-only access, so you can see the flat but not approve visitors or pay bills.

empty.title: No flat assigned yet
empty.description: The society office assigns your flat. Contact them if you think this is wrong.

visitors.title: Visitors and passes
visitors.intro: Only visitors for your own flat are shown here.
visitors.name: Name
visitors.cancelled: {{name}}’s visit is cancelled. The guard will not let them in.
visitors.parcelsDescription: Show this code at the gate, or tap Collected once you have it.
visitors.leaveAtGateHint: Leave at gate is for deliveries. Your answer is separate from the guard’s final decision at the gate.
visitors.recentDescription: What happened at the gate for your flat.
visitors.createDescription: Pre-approve someone. They show the code at the gate and walk in without waiting for you.
visitors.mobileHint: The pass is sent here by SMS.
visitors.notePlaceholder: Parcel can be left with security
visitors.created: Pass created. The entry code is {{code}}.
visitors.needFullAccess: You have view-only access to this flat, so you cannot create a pass.
visitors.passesDescription: An active pass works once at the gate unless you chose comes and goes.
visitors.shareText: Your CivicKey entry code is {{code}}. Valid {{date}}, {{from}} to {{to}}. Show it at the gate.

empty.title: Nobody is waiting
empty.description: When a guard registers a visitor for your flat, the request appears here.

noPasses.title: No passes yet
noPasses.description: Create one for a guest, a delivery or a plumber you are expecting.

dailyHelp.title: Daily help
dailyHelp.description: Staff who work for your flat. You are told when they enter and leave.
dailyHelp.noAttendance: Nothing recorded in the last two weeks.

empty.title: No daily help yet
empty.description: Add your maid, cook or driver below. The office verifies ID and photo, then issues a gate pass.

dailyHelp.intro: Your maid, cook or driver: what the office verified, when they came in, and who to add.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.description: Guards use these to let your vehicles in without stopping them.

empty.title: No vehicles registered
empty.description: Add the cars and two-wheelers that belong to this flat.

requests.title: Ask the society office
requests.description: The office checks ID and photo before anything is created.
requests.name: Name
requests.householdHint: The society admin approves the request before the account is created.
requests.helpHint: The society office verifies ID and photo, then issues the staff pass.
requests.sent: Sent. The office will review your request for {{name}}.
requests.needFullAccess: You have view-only access to this flat, so you cannot send a request.

HOUSEHOLD_MEMBER.title: Add a family member
HOUSEHOLD_MEMBER.description: The society admin checks ID before the account is created.

DAILY_HELP.title: Add daily help
DAILY_HELP.description: Give the name and timings. The office verifies ID and photo, then issues the gate pass.

bills.title: Bills and receipts
bills.intro: Bills for your flat only. View-only members can see bills but cannot pay.
bills.payOffline: Pay at the society office. The committee records it and your receipt appears below. Online payment is not switched on yet.
bills.historyDescription: Every bill raised for your flat, newest first.

settled.title: Nothing due
settled.description: Every bill raised for your flat has been paid.

empty.title: No bills yet
empty.description: Bills appear here once the society generates them for the month.

bills.payPending: The receipt appears here once your bank confirms the payment, usually within a minute.
bills.receiptPending: That receipt is still being prepared. Try again in a minute.
bills.paySuccess: Payment confirmed. Your receipt appears below.
bills.payFailed: The bank did not confirm that payment. Nothing has been charged against this bill.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: What still needs an answer from you, and what has changed since you last looked.
notifications.pendingDescription: Visitors waiting at the gate and bills still to pay.
notifications.footnote: Turn on push to hear about visitors while this page is closed. Email goes out for bills and receipts.

clear.title: Nothing waiting on you
clear.description: No visitor is at the gate and no bill is outstanding.

empty.title: Nothing to show
empty.description: Once visitors, passes and bills start moving, they appear here.

notifications.sentDescription: The notices CivicKey sent you, newest first.
notifications.offline: Real-time updates unavailable. Notifications will refresh automatically.

push.offer: Get alerted on this device when a visitor is at your gate.
push.denied: This browser is blocking notifications. Allow them in your browser settings to use push.

guard.title: Gate operations

stats.expectedHint: passes for today · {{count}} visits so far

validatePass.label: Validate pass
validatePass.description: Scan QR or enter pass ID

guard.noSociety: Your guard account is not linked to a society yet. Ask the society office to set it up.

register.title: Register a visitor
register.intro: Large fields for a tablet at the gate. The resident is asked to approve, and the entry is recorded here.
register.passDescription: Type the six-digit entry code and the rest of the form fills itself in.
register.passUnknown: No pass has this entry code
register.formDescription: The mobile number comes first: a returning visitor is recognised by it.
register.mobileHint: Enter this first. A returning visitor fills in automatically.
register.name: Visitor name
register.flatHint: Shows the flat number and who lives there.
register.residentHint: Who the visitor asked for. Their approval is the one requested.
register.noteRequired: Say what the visitor is here for
register.afterSending: No answer in 2 minutes? Call the intercom, then record your own decision at the gate.
register.noApprover: Nobody in this flat can approve right now. Call {{name}} on {{phone}}; the visit stays unapproved until someone answers in the app.
register.receiptDescription: The record as it was saved. It cannot be edited or cancelled here.
register.receiptReadOnly: To correct a detail, register the visitor again. This record stays as it is.
register.sent: Sent to the flat. {{name}} is waiting for the resident’s answer.
register.letIn: {{name}} has a valid pass, so they are approved already.

gate.title: Pass validation, gate and staff
gate.intro: Check a pass, verify a staff member, and keep the inside list honest.
gate.passDescription: The resident pre-approved this person; the code proves it.
gate.validPass: Valid pass · pre-approved by the resident
gate.passUnknown: No pass has this entry code
gate.refusedHint: An expired, used or cancelled pass shows in red with the reason, and cannot be allowed.
gate.staffDescription: Compare the person with the photo on file before recording.
gate.staffUnknown: No staff member has this pass number
gate.name: Name
gate.turnedAway: {{name}} was turned away at the gate.
gate.parcelsDescription: Deliveries the flat asked you to keep. Taking one in is not letting anybody inside.
gate.parcelKept: {{name}}’s delivery is recorded at the gate.
gate.comparePhoto: The flats they serve are told automatically.
gate.rejected: {{name}} was refused. The reason is on the record.
gate.approvedDescription: The resident said yes. Record the entry when they come in.
gate.insideDescription: Visitors and staff who have not been recorded out yet.

empty.title: Nobody is inside
empty.description: Entries you record at the gate appear here until you record the exit.

gate.offlinePassReason: Pass checked against the cached copy while the gate was offline

log.title: Gate log
log.intro: Every entry and exit recorded at the gate, with the numbers you are asked for at handover.
log.entriesHint: Visitors and staff, counted as they came in
log.exitsHint: Exits you closed on this day
log.allAccountedFor: Everyone who came in is out
log.averageStayHint: Over the visits that ended on this day
log.turnedAwayHint: Denied, or left at the gate, by the flat
log.mixDescription: Entries by purpose, so a day of deliveries reads as one.
log.movementsDescription: Newest first. An entry and its exit are two lines.

empty.title: Nothing was recorded
empty.description: No entry or exit was recorded at the gate on this day.

occupancy.title: Society occupancy
occupancy.description: Flats across the society, and how full each block is today.

people.title: Users and staff
people.description: Who lives here now, and who works here.

money.title: Billing this month
money.description: Raised, received and still owed for the current month.
money.collectedShare: {{percent}}% of this month has been collected.
money.notGenerated: No invoices have been generated for this month yet.

noSociety.title: No society yet
noSociety.description: Your account is not linked to a society. Contact your administrator.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: Kept in the audit trail with your name. At least 3 characters.

details.title: Society details
details.description: The society as it is registered, and how residents and guards reach the office.
details.name: Society name
details.gstinHint: Only if the society charges GST on maintenance.

structure.title: Blocks, floors and flats
structure.description: The whole hierarchy, with what is sold and who lives there.
structure.noFlats: No flats on this floor yet.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.addDescription: Every floor belongs to a block, so the first block comes before anything else.
blocks.name: Block name

empty.title: No blocks yet
empty.description: Add the first block to start building the society structure.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this block?
deactivate.description: Block {{name}} stops being available for new floors and flats. Nothing already recorded is deleted.

floors.title: Floors in this block
floors.addDescription: Choose the block first; a floor always belongs to one block.
floors.label: Floor label
floors.labelHint: Free text: B2, Ground, 1st Floor, Terrace.
floors.orderHint: Optional. Negative values sort basements first.
floors.chooseFirstDescription: Pick a block above to see and manage its floors.

empty.title: No floors in this block
empty.description: Add a floor before adding flats to it.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this floor?
deactivate.description: {{label}} stops being available for new flats. Nothing already recorded is deleted.

flats.title: Flats on this floor
flats.addDescription: Choose the block and then one of its floors. Only floors of the chosen block are listed.
flats.chooseFirstDescription: A flat belongs to a floor, so pick the block and floor above first.
flats.maxOccupantsHint: Tenants only; owners never take a slot.

empty.title: No flats on this floor
empty.description: Add the first flat to this floor.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this flat?
deactivate.description: Flat {{number}} stops being available for new residents. Nothing already recorded is deleted.

flats.carpetAreaHint: Used to work out the maintenance charge.
flats.parkingHint: Separate the slots with commas; the count is worked out from them.
flats.intercomHint: Guards call this to confirm a visitor.

residents.title: Residents and tenants
residents.description: Owners and tenants of this society, current and past.
residents.searchPlaceholder: Name, mobile, flat or flat id
residents.searchHint: Try a resident name, a mobile number, 101, A-101, or paste a flat id.
residents.flatDescription: Everyone registered to this flat, current and past.
residents.rejectDescription: {{name}} is not given access to the flat. The reason is kept in the audit trail.
residents.closeDescription: {{name}} loses access to the flat from today. A new registration is needed to bring them back.

empty.title: No residents match
empty.description: Change the filters, or register a resident from the Flats tab.

register.title: Register a resident for flat {{number}}
register.description: Creates the account if the mobile number is new. The registration waits for verification before it gives access.
register.name: Full name
register.accessHint: View only is for children and other family members.
register.endDateHint: Leave this empty while the tenant is living here. It is recorded when they move out.
register.idLast4Hint: Never the full number; only the last 4 characters are stored.
register.proofHint: Sale deed or rent agreement reference.

gates.title: Gates
gates.description: Guards are posted to a gate. Every entry and exit records which gate it happened at.
gates.name: Gate name

empty.title: No gates yet
empty.description: Add the gates people use, so a guard can be posted to one.

deactivate.title: Close this gate?
deactivate.description: {{name}} stops being available for new postings. Entries already recorded keep it.

loginCode.title: One-time login code for {{name}}
loginCode.hint: Hand it over in person or send it yourself: CivicKey does not send messages yet. They set their own password with it.
loginCode.shareText: Your CivicKey one-time code is {{code}}. Open the app, tap "Forgot password?" and use it to set your password. It works once.

settings.title: Society settings
settings.description: Choices that apply to the whole society.
settings.idRequired: Require a government ID for staff
settings.idRequiredHint: Staff cannot be registered without an ID type and number. Only the type and last 4 digits are ever shown.
settings.leaveAtGateHint: A resident may ask the guard to keep a parcel or a food delivery at the gate.
settings.purposesHint: Untick the ones this society does not use. At least one stays on.
settings.validityHoursHint: How long a gate registration can still be used for an entry. 24 by default.
settings.photoRetentionDaysHint: After this many days past a closed visit, the photo is deleted. The visit and its audit trail stay. 90 by default.

backups.title: Database backup
backups.description: An encrypted copy of the whole database, for this self-hosted server.
backups.empty: No backup has been exported yet.
backups.note: A backup is encrypted with the server’s backup key and the link works once, within 15 minutes. Keep the file somewhere safe: without the key it cannot be read.

addUser.intro: Creates the account and the flat registration. The admin never sets or sees a password.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role decides which dashboard this person gets. Owner and tenant are chosen below, under the flat.

RESIDENT.label: Resident
RESIDENT.description: Owner or tenant of a flat

notYet.title: {{role}} accounts are not created here yet
notYet.GUARD: Guards are added under Staff management, which has no API yet. This form only creates residents.
notYet.ADMIN: An Admin account is created by another Admin, and a committee member is a resident given committee permissions. Neither has an endpoint yet.

personal.title: Personal details
personal.languageHint: Used for notices sent to this person.

signIn.title: Sign-in and contact
signIn.description: The mobile number is the sign-in ID.
signIn.phoneHint: 10 digits. Must not already belong to another society.
signIn.emailHint: Optional. Can also be used to sign in.

flat.title: Flat and household
flat.description: Links the person to a flat. Residents only see their own flat.

identity.title: Identity verification
identity.description: Used by the society to verify who lives at the premises.
identity.aadhaar: Never type the full Aadhaar number. Only the document type and its last 4 characters are kept, and the number itself never reaches the database.
identity.consent: The person agreed to share this ID for society verification, and was told why it is collected and who can see it.

emergency.title: Emergency contact
emergency.description: Who the society calls if something happens to this person.
emergency.name: Name

onSave.title: What happens on save
onSave.account: The account is created if the mobile number is new, and the resident role is assigned.
onSave.pending: The registration starts pending. It gives no access until an Admin verifies it under Approvals.
onSave.audit: The action is recorded in the audit log with your name.

notStored.title: Not collected yet
notStored.description: On the printed form but with nowhere to store it, so these are left out rather than silently dropped:
notStored.documents: ID copies, rental agreement and police verification
notStored.invite: The SMS invite and OTP, so a resident cannot sign in until that ticket lands

addUser.noFlats: There are no flats yet. Add a block, a floor and a flat under Society & users first.

staff.intro: Guards need Manage guards. Daily help and staff passes need Register staff.
staff.listDescription: Search by name or mobile number.
staff.name: Full name
staff.noGates: Add a gate under Society & users first.
staff.flatsServedHint: The flat’s residents see this person under Daily help and are told when they enter or leave.
staff.passToHint: Leave empty for no end date.
staff.consent: The staff member agreed to share their photo and ID for gate verification.
staff.saved: {{name}} saved, and the staff pass issued.

addDescription.GUARD: Guards are posted to a gate on a shift, and scan passes at that gate.
addDescription.DAILY_HELP: Maids, cooks, drivers and others who work for one or more flats. Each gets a staff pass the guard scans at the gate.
addDescription.VENDOR: Plumbers, electricians and other service staff working for the society.

empty.title: Nobody here yet
empty.description: Add the first person with the button above.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this staff member?
deactivate.description: {{name}}’s pass stops working at the gate. Nothing already recorded is deleted.

staff.idReason: Why is the ID being read?
staff.idReasonHint: Kept in the audit log with your name. The number is not stored in this browser.

postings.title: Gate postings
postings.empty: This guard has not been posted to a gate yet.

billing.intro: Each panel appears only to admins who hold the permission shown under its title.

rates.title: Maintenance rates

bases.PER_SQFT: Per sq ft of carpet area

rates.effectiveFromHint: Old rates stay on bills already generated.

payment.title: Record a cash payment
payment.paidByPlaceholder: Name of the person who paid
payment.receiptNote: A receipt number is created automatically and the resident sees it in their app. A cash entry cannot be deleted, only reversed, and both are recorded in the audit log.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: What has been billed, what has been paid, and the receipts behind each one.
invoices.noReceipts: Nothing received against this invoice yet.
invoices.reverseDescription: Receipt {{receipt}} stays on the record, and the amount goes back on the invoice.

empty.title: Nothing billed yet
empty.description: Generate the first month’s invoices above.

reports.intro: Read back from the invoices and assignments themselves; nothing here is cached.
reports.title: Reports

empty.title: Nothing to report
empty.description: There is no data for this report and period yet.

security.intro: Who did what, newest first. The trail is written by the server and cannot be edited.
security.title: Security activity

empty.title: Nothing recorded yet
empty.description: Activity shows up here as people use the society’s account.

tasks.title: Community tasks
tasks.intro: The society's own work list: what needs doing in the common areas, and who is doing it.
tasks.listDescription: Open work first, most pressing at the top.
tasks.formDescription: Say what needs doing and, if you already know, who should do it.
tasks.cancelDescription: Say why “{{title}}” is being cancelled. The task stays on the list with the reason.

fields.title: What needs doing
fields.assigneeHint: Daily help and vendors on the society’s staff. Guards are not listed.
fields.detailsPlaceholder: Anything the person doing the work needs to know

empty.title: Nothing on the list
empty.description: Raise a task when something in the common areas needs doing.

staffMovement.title: Staff movement
staffMovement.intro: What the gate recorded: staff entries, exits and refused entries. Read only; a profile going inactive keeps its history.
staffMovement.filtersDescription: Filters apply to the list below. Leave one empty to include everything.

empty.title: No staff movement recorded
empty.description: Nothing matches these filters. The gate records an event the moment a guard verifies someone.

visitorMovement.title: Visitor movement
visitorMovement.intro: What the gate recorded: visitor entries, exits and refusals. Read only; an expiry never writes an exit, and a visitor who never arrived is not here.
visitorMovement.filtersDescription: Filters apply to the list below. Leave one empty to include everything.

empty.title: No visitor movement recorded
empty.description: Nothing matches these filters. The gate records an event the moment a guard lets someone in, out, or turns them away.

sync.empty: Nothing recorded on this device yet.
sync.liveNote: Entries saved offline reach residents only after they sync. A resident has not been asked or told until then.
sync.savedHere: Saved on this device — waiting to sync.

photo.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. The photo is kept privately and shown only inside CivicKey.
